Hi Aliya —

Great to meet you last week. As discussed on the call, I wanted to start the MAP (mutual action plan) thread so we have a single place to track goals, owners, and the close timeline for the pilot. High-level proposal below:

- Goal: 6-week evaluation of Redwood inference on QuantMed clinical-search pipeline, target metrics: 85%+ relevance with latency under 200ms P50.
- Key dates: kickoff week of 6/7, pilot complete by 7/19, decision meeting 7/22.
- Owners: QuantMed champion (you) for success criteria & test data access; Redwood AE (me) for timelines and deployment support; CS (Marissa) for enablement and eval instrumentation.

I've attached a one-page MAP draft and a short evaluation checklist to this thread (QuantMed_MAP_v0.1.xlsx; evaluation-checklist.pdf). Please confirm if the goals and dates look reasonable from your side and who else on your team should be included (procurement, security, engineering).

If it helps, I can lock a 30-minute MAP orientation next Tues (6/8) or Wed (6/9) to align owners and acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0197
